insight.brutal-momentum.outcome: Brutal Momentum: once per turn after your qualifying completed event, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, using a legal destination and route.
insight.brutal-momentum.why: Sealed ownership row consumed by combat/ext/brutal_momentum.py through completed-event receipts. No row means no movement, prompt or turn flag.

insight.alchemical-constitution.why: Printed Advantage on saving throws against Poison and alchemical backlash, compiled through the generic defense block: pressure.save_advantage reads it for every typed save against the Poisoned condition, fixed Poison damage, or a save a producer classifies with save_categories -- the consumer the typed authority's path_passive save_advantage row already names (insights_b.json's legacy-tempered-organs is the same shape). Alchemical backlash is a failed-Alchemy-Check crafting hazard (Sphere Compendium: 'Natural 1. The ingredients are lost and you suffer backlash. Take 1d6 Fire, Poison, Acid, or Force damage per rarity tier'), rolled between Full Cultivation Sessions; no combat save producer classifies one, so the clause is provenance-complete and inert until a producer tags it, and no save is broadened. combat/ext/alchemy_constitution.py carries the same advantage to a condition's repeat save through the documented save_mode hook. Extra Assimilation (one additional Cultivation or Enhancement pill beyond the Pill Saturation allowance, once between Full Cultivation Sessions, still paying 1 Pill Impurity and every other cost) is pill preparation outside the fight; it remains a printed rider.

insight.borrowed-golden-form.outcome: Borrowed Golden Form: a Bonus Action that costs 4 Qi, once per scene, lets you choose one Golden Core Form you do not possess and gain its unperfected benefits until the scene ends.
insight.borrowed-golden-form.why: Sealed Insight combat clauses; combat/ext/borrowed_golden_form.py records the borrowed Form on the shared Golden Core Form condition (combat/ext/qi_path.py form_state), so every Golden Core benefit reader grants the unperfected amounts.

insight.bone-general.outcome: Bone General: your Death Control Limit is 1 higher for Corpse Servants and Lesser Corpse Servants only, and one commanded Death servant may move up to 10 feet before taking its action when you command Death servants.
insight.bone-general.why: Sealed Insight combat clauses; combat/ext/bone_general.py answers the general control_limit_extra seam (combat/summons.py) and the general command_resolved seam (combat/typed_executor.py).

insight.battle-musician.outcome: Battle Musician: Constitution is your Music key ability for Cadence talents; you may spend Stamina instead of Cultivation Points for Music talents performed entirely through voice, breath, heartbeat, footwork, weapon impact, body percussion or movement; and Opening Phrase is free once per turn after you take the Attack action while Keeping the Measure.
insight.battle-musician.why: Sealed Insight combat clauses; combat/ext/battle_musician.py re-keys the Cadence talents' compiled numbers (compile_action), offers the Stamina payment for the other embodied Music talents (payment_substitution), and publishes the free Opening Phrase variants (compile_actions, candidate_allowed, action_completed). The Source CL and embodied-maintenance clauses are already automated by the engine (one Cultivation Level per character; Keep the Measure is method-agnostic).

insight.body-as-center.outcome: Body as Center: when you use Gravitic Pull, Gravity Well, Crushing Field or Flight Suppression, you may center the effect on your body, reducing the Stamina actually paid by 1 (minimum 1); the area moves with you only until the start of your next turn, then remains at its current location for the rest of its duration.
insight.body-as-center.why: Sealed Insight combat clauses; combat/ext/body_as_center.py publishes centered variants of the four talents (compile_actions) and answers the general zone_follows seam (combat/zones.py follows_now) so a centered area rides its owner only until the start of the owner's next turn.
